functional.summary: Story-level functional evidence for mis-selection. The live end-to-end check was run on the host against the real client workbook during task 3, and the product code on this closeout tree is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the merged master that was exercised (`git diff origin/master HEAD -- backend frontend contract tools` is empty), so the evidence applies unchanged. Signed in with the mock OTP, reached MIS Reports from the now-enabled nav item, selected Agriculture / Nursery / Agri - Nursery - DUB / 2026-07-01 and pressed Generate: the resolved scope named 7 cost centres, 28 GL codes and nursery-mis-financial-v1; totals showed Actual Rs 1,15,12,712.07; 28 governed GL rows rendered with the month as 'Jul 2026' and the percentage measure as its designed label 'over-budget' (zero occurrences of NaN); and the unmapped-GL bucket rendered as a reviewable list of 9 rows, each with an Actual and a Budget amount and its reason. That run also covers the story's acceptance criteria 1 and 2; criterion 3 (no mapping renders zeros plus the notice, no crash) is proven by the component and controller tests, because the single-selection master makes the unresolvable branch unreachable from the live UI.
non_blocking_findings: The period select shows raw ISO dates because the options route returns the ISO date as its label; ledgered as D-0030 (renumbered from D-0028 in selection-ui's own evidence).
residual_risks: The Budget side reads Rs 0.00 because the real budget workbook cannot be ingested: mis-budget.parser.ts cellText() calls toISOString() on an Invalid Date exceljs produces for one cell in Nursery MIS Format.xlsx. Budget rendering is proven structurally, not with non-zero live values. Ledgered as D-0029 (renumbered from D-0027) and it BLOCKS mis-statement, which needs live Budget.

The vitest required_test gate cannot fail closed on a drifted leaf name; selection-ui's four leaves were proven by demonstrated positive/negative control instead. Ledgered as D-0031 (renumbered from D-0029).
